regime_context: The detector state is consistent with its own verdict: discipline_not_prediction. Cross-sectional momentum carries no forward edge (it is an attention/focus lens), rotation-timing is display-only, and the one validated edge — the absolute-trend gate — did help drawdown control on this market's history (gate_helps=true), so trend-following leans are modestly more defensible than they would be otherwise, but no rank here predicts return. Track record (n=54) shows 66.7% of calls were 'hits' by the detector's own definition but dir_accuracy of ~48% means directional calls were near coin-flip; conviction should default low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Silver Miners' breadth (currently 0.75) and non-crowded z-score (~0.53) hold while the rank-1 Memory leader mean-reverts; a confirmed handoff would need Silver to close the score gap to within ~0.5 while keeping breadth above 0.6 — until then it is only a challenger, not a rotation.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the strongest mean-revert-free theme in the top ranks: hurst_tag 'trend' (unlike rank-1 Memory which is mean-revert), highest breadth in the top 5 (0.917), durability_bar 0.73, and modest crowding (z=0.22, not crowded). This is a trend-following, trend-gate-friendly lean rather than a momentum chase — the theme is broadly participated (breadth) and the top-ranked Memory theme is explicitly mean-reverting with zero breadth, so Gold Miners looks like the sturdier stay-forward candidate.
evidence: hurst_tag 'trend' vs 'mean-revert' for Memory/HBM (rank 1) and AI Infra (rank 4)
breadth 0.917, highest among top-5 eligible names
theses.dissent: Gold miners are a macro/real-rates trade more than a self-sustaining trend; the macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics (25/50 mentions) and unscheduled_share 0.94, meaning a sudden risk-on headline reversal could unwind the safety bid quickly, and the detector provides no predictive edge on that path.

falsifier.text: GDX underperforms SPY by 8% or more cumulatively before the 40-trading-day check

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is rank 2, eligible, not crowded (z=0.53), with strong breadth (0.75) and mixed-to-trend durability (bar 0.63). The rotation structure shows it as the nearest challenger to the leader, but this is NOT treated as a handoff call — it is simply a non-crowded, broad-based trend candidate that avoids the reflexivity risk of the crowded mean-revert leader (Memory).
evidence: rotation margin vs leader 1.975 (no confirmed handoff)
theses.dissent: Silver's industrial-demand beta ties it to the same growth/AI-capital-spend complex the detector does not predict; if the crowded Memory/HBM theme mean-reverts down hard, correlated semiconductor-adjacent sentiment could drag silver miners despite the precious-metals cushion.

falsifier.text: SIL lags GDX by 5% or more on a cumulative basis before the 30-trading-day check

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The leader is mean-revert (hurst_tag mean-revert), crowded (z=1.44, crowded=true), with zero breadth (0.0) — the negative combination the trend-gate discipline is built to sidestep. Do-not-conclude rules forbid fading a crowded leader, and forbid treating the rank lead as a buy. 'Avoid' here is a sizing/participation caution for the trend allocator, not a short or a directional bear call — leave it alone rather than chase it.
evidence: guardrails: 'Do NOT treat the momentum rank as a buy list', 'Do NOT fade the dominant theme'
theses.dissent: Reflexivity in a one-narrative tape can keep the leader running far longer than mean-reversion norms suggest; avoiding it may underperform near-term, and the guardrail explicitly warns fading the leader is the documented failure mode — so the honest risk is opportunity cost, not capital loss.

falsifier.text: SMH (proxy) sets a fresh 20-day or 60-day high and holds it for 5 consecutive sessions before the check date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
